title: Alexander
desc: CBI officer Alexander investigates a complex case involving murder, smuggling and political corruption. However, his search leads him to a dangerous game of cat and mouse with powerful adversaries.

title: Karmegam
desc: A military officer returns home to find his village stuck in the past, under the thumb of an abusive landlord. He urges them to revolt against their oppressor and learns a dark secret about his past.

title: Oru Thaai Makkal
desc: A rich man adopts one of the twin sons of his maid after his own child dies. However, fate brings the brothers face to face when they both fall in love with the same woman.

title: Narathan
desc: Vishnu is on his way to Chennai from Coimbatore to join a new company and meet his fiancée. However, his plan is jeopardised upon meeting Pavithra on a train, who is stuck in a problem.

title: Thavamai Thavamirunthu
desc: Saradha and Muthaiah, a village-based couple, face financial difficulties while raising their two sons, Ramanathan and Ramalingam. Problems escalate when Ramalingam gets his girlfriend pregnant.
